subject: Consolidated Art.30 register, system architecture & DPIA handover
messages:
From: Molly Schaefer <molly.schaefer@elmbridge-consulting.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Art.30 register + architecture for Elmbridge DPIA handover

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for taking this call last week. Elmbridge is finalising the desktop DPIA for our client (Nordica Health) and we need a small packet of evidence from Redwood to close the control gap: specifically an up-to-date Art.30 register export (processing activities), a concise system architecture diagram that highlights cross-border flows and the components that touch customer data, and a short (1–2 page) DPIA executive summary that explains hosting/processing locations and subprocessors.

Can you confirm whether you can provide: 1) the Article 30 CSV export, 2) the infra diagram (PDF), and 3) the exec summary (docx) by the end of the week? Nordica is aiming to submit next Wednesday. If there are any constraints around redaction or a signed NDA, flag them and we’ll route the paperwork.

Also: can you confirm whether the latest subprocessor list includes the new EU cache layer we discussed (eu-cache-ops)? That detail needs to be explicit in the register.

Appreciate it —
Molly
Principal, Elmbridge Consulting
security@elmbridge-consulting.com

Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Molly Schaefer <molly.schaefer@elmbridge-consulting.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Art.30 register + architecture for Elmbridge DPIA handover

Hi Molly —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can deliver the three artefacts you listed but a couple operational notes up front:

- Art.30 register: we will export the processing ledger for the Elmbridge/Nordica scoped tenant and include a csv column that lists active subprocessors and their processing locations. We will flag the eu-cache-ops entry and add the cache IP ranges where available.
- Infra diagram (rdw_infra_diagram_v3.pdf): the diagram will show regions, network boundaries (VPCs), and data flow arrows. For security reasons we won’t publish internal hostnames; we’ll provide a redacted view with component roles (e.g., inference-gateway, cache-layer, metrics-proxy).
- DPIA exec summary: 1–2 pages with hosting locations, legal basis summary, and mitigations.

Rishi — can you pull the Article 30 export and confirm subprocessors list is current for Elmbridge (including eu-cache-ops)? Marissa — can you review the exec summary draft and infra diagram once Rishi shares the export?

We may need a short Elmbridge signature on a limited-scope transfer attestation if they require export-level access to logs. Let me know if that’s requested.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy Ops, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Art.30 register + architecture for Elmbridge DPIA handover

Kim / team —

I pulled the processing ledger for the Elmbridge/Nordica scope and attached a CSV export (redwood_article30_register.csv). Notes from the export:

- The eu-cache-ops entry is present (subprocessor id: eu-cache-ops-004) and the entry lists an EU processing location (Frankfurt) and a short description: "short-lived KV cache for inference prefix caching".
- Two older subprocessors (log-analytics-legacy) were deprecated last month and marked as inactive; I left those rows in the CSV but added an "inactive" tag.
- Cross-border flows: there is a service-to-service flow where telemetry and aggregated usage metrics are forwarded to a metrics bucket in us-west2 — this is listed and has the lawful basis of "contractual necessity" in the ledger.

I also attached a draft infra diagram (rdw_infra_diagram_v3.pdf) with redaction of internal hostnames but showing VPCs and region labels.

Two follow-ups for compliance:
1) We can include the IP ranges for eu-cache-ops but that is operational and may need network team sign-off; do you want those in the visible diagram or as a separate attachment?
2) Logs access: Elmbridge asked for event-level agent logs for a 14-day sampling window — that requires a narrow scoped evidence manifest and an access policy update. Suggest we request a signed purpose-limited attestation from Elmbridge before granting the sample.

Files attached: redwood_article30_register.csv, rdw_infra_diagram_v3.pdf, evidence-manifest.json

-Rishi
Senior Security Engineer

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Molly Schaefer <molly.schaefer@elmbridge-consulting.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Art.30 register + architecture for Elmbridge DPIA handover

Hi Molly —

Attached:
- redwood_article30_register.csv (CSV export of Art.30-style ledger for Elmbridge/Nordica scope)
- rdw_infra_diagram_v3.pdf (redacted infra diagram; components labelled by role and region)
- dpia-executive-summary.docx (1.5 page summary for DPIA submission)
- evidence-manifest.json (index of artifacts and any redaction notes)

Quick notes:
- The eu-cache-ops subprocessor is present and marked with EU processing (Frankfurt).
- The Art.30 register includes a column "data_flow_crossborder" that flags flows to US-based analytics buckets — these are called out in the summary and the ledger rows include lawful basis and retention.
- We will not provide event-level agent logs without a signed, purpose-limited attestation and IP whitelisting for access. If Elmbridge confirms that they only need the register/diagram/summary for the DPIA submission, we can close this ticket.

Molly — if you need the IP ranges or the 14-day sample, please reply with a short attestation template and the justification. Otherwise, please confirm receipt and whether the three artefacts satisfy Nordica's DPIA cutoff next Wednesday.

Thanks —
Kim

Attachment stubs: redwood_article30_register.csv, rdw_infra_diagram_v3.pdf, dpia-executive-summary.docx, evidence-manifest.json
